articles.title: Phish brought near-record crowds to this Fenway dispensary — but not a product shortage
articles.description:
"The energy was real high."

The post Phish brought near-record crowds to this Fenway dispensary — but not a product shortage appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Phish concert attracted large crowds to a Fenway dispensary on August 1, 2026.
Dispensary reported near-record sales without any product shortages during the event.
Local businesses benefited from increased foot traffic and sales due to the concert.
